English: The sub-Antarctic Prince Edward Islands (PEIs) constitute South Africa’s most remote territory.

English: Here, we review what is known about invasions to the PEIs for terrestrial taxa (vertebrates, invertebrates, plants and microbes), freshwater taxa and marine taxa.
Luganda: Wano, twekaliriza ebyo ebimanyiddwa ku kulumbibwa kwa PEIs okuva ku biramu (ebirina omugongo, ebitalina mugongo, ebimera n’obuwuka obusirikiti), ebiramu eby’omu mazzi n’ebiramu eby’omu mayanja.
Yoruba: Níbi, a ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò ohun tí a mọ̀ sí nípa àfòmọ́ ajòjì ọgánísíìmù sí PEIs fún ìpin ohun abẹ̀mí orí ilẹ̀ (àwọn ẹranko ọlọ́pàá-ẹ̀yìn, àwọn ẹranko tí kò ní ọ̀pá-ẹ̀yìn, ewéko àti àwọn máíkíróòbù) àwọn ohun abẹ̀mi inú omi mímọ́ àti àwọn ohun abẹ̀mi inú omi òkun.
Zulu: Lapha, sibuyekeza lokho okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhlaselwa kwama-PEI nge-terrestrial taxa (izilwane ezinomgogodla, izilwane ezingenamgogodla, izitshalo kanye namagciwane), i-taxa yamanzi ahlanzekile kanye ne-marine taxa.
Hausa: A nan, mun sake nazarin abin da aka sani game da mamayewa ga PEIs don rukunonin dabbobin kan ƙasa (masu ƙashin baya da marasa ƙashin baya da tsirrai da kuma ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta), rukunonin dabbobin ruwa mai tsabta da kuma rukunonin dabbobin teku.
Northern Sotho: Mo, re lekodišiša seo se tsebjago ka ga go šwahlela go di-PEI go mehuta ya diphedi tša mafelo a kgakala (diphoofolo tša mekokotlo, diphoofolo tša go hloka marapo a mekokotlo, dimela le dimaekheroupu), mehuta ya diphedi tša ka meetseng a foreše le mehuta ya diphedi tša ka lewatleng.

English: Currently, Marion Island is home to 46 alien species, of which 29 are known to be invasive (i.e. they are alien species that have established and spread on the island).

Yoruba: Lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, ilé ni Marion Island jẹ́ fún àwọn ajòjì ọ́gánísíìmù 46, èyí tí ó jẹ́ pé 29 nínú wọn jé àfòmọ́ (fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n jẹ́ tí wọ́n tí gbilẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì fọ́nká gbogbo erékùsù).

Hausa: A halin yanzu, Tsibirin Marion yana zama gida ga baƙin jinsuna guda 46, wanda 29 aka sani da zama masu mamaya (wato su ne baƙin jinsuna da suka kafu kuma suka yaɗu a tsibirin).

Amharic: በአሁኑ ጊዜ፣ ማሪዮን ደሴት 29ቱ ወራሪ መሆናቸው የታወቁ፣ የ46 ባዕዳን ዝርያዎች መኖሪያ ነው (ይህም በደሴቱ ላይ የተመሰረቱ እና የተስፋፉ የባዕዳን ዝርያዎች ናቸው)።

English: The House Mouse (Mus musculus), which occurs on Marion Island, can be considered the most detrimental invader to the islands; it impacts on plants, insects and seabirds, which result in changes to ecosystem functioning.
Luganda: Emmese ez’omu nju (Mus musculus), ezibeera ku kizinga kya Marion Island, kitwalibwa ng’ekisenguse ekisinga okuba eky’omutawaana ku bizinga; kikosa ebimera, ebiwuka n’ebinyonyi by’oku mayanja, era nga kino kireetawo enkyukakyuka mu nkola y’obutonde.

Hausa: Ɓeran gida (Mus musculus), wanda yake a Tsibirin Marion, ana iya ɗaukar sa a matsayin mafi haɗarin mai mamayewa ga tsibirin; yana tasiri a kan tsirrai da ƙwari da tsuntsayen teku, wanda ya haifar da sauye-sauye ga aikin yanayin halittu.
Northern Sotho: House Mouse (Mus musculus), yeo e lego gona ka Marion Island, e ka bonwa bjalo ka sephedi sa go šwahlela seo se senyago kudu ka dihlakahlakeng; se ama dimela, dikhunkhwane le dinonyana tša lewatleng, gomme se se feletša ka diphetogo go go šoma ga phedišano ya diphedi.

Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ɓerayen gida sun fi cutar da wasu jinsunan da ba na asali ba da aka gabatar da su a Tsibirin Marion da yake gaɓar tekun Afirka ta Kudu, sama da shekaru 100 da suka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore magotlo a dintlong ke diphedi tše di sego tša tlhago ya fao tšeo di senyago kudu tšeo di tlišitšwego ka Marion Island, ka lebopong la Afrika Borwa, mo mengwageng ya go feta ye 100 ye e fetilego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ከ100 ዓመታት በፊት በደቡብ አፍሪካ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በምትገኘው፣ ማሪዮን ደሴት፣ ከተዋወቁት በርካታ አገር በቀል ያልሆኑ ዝርያዎች ሁሉ የቤት አይጦች በጣም ጎጂ ናቸው ብለዋል።

English: They’ve written a book chapter describing what we know about these mice and other invasive species on the islands.
Luganda: Bawandiise essuula mu kitabo nga bannyonnyola bye tumanyi ku mmese ne ku ndyo endala ensenguse ku bizinga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ti kọ orí ìwé tí wọ́n fi ṣe àlàyé ohun tí a mọ̀ nípa àwọn eku wọ̀nyí àti àwọn ajòjì ọ́gánísíìmù ní àwọn erékùsù.
Zulu: Babhale isahluko sencwadi esichaza esikwaziyo ngala magundane nezinye izinhlobo ezihlaselayo eziqhingini.
Hausa: Sun rubuta babi na littafi wanda yake bayyana abin da muka sani game da waɗannan ɓerayen da sauran jinsuna masu mamayewa a tsibirin.
Northern Sotho: Ba ngwadile kgaolo ya ka gare ga puku yeo e hlalošago seo re se tsebago ka ga magotlo a le mehuta ye mengwe ya go šwahlela dihlakahlakaneng.
Amharic: ስለእነዚህ አይጦች እና ሌሎች በደሴቶች ላይ ስለሚገኙ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች የምናውቀውን የሚገልጽ የመጽሐፍ ምዕራፍ ጽፈዋል።

English: South Africa has in its territory a large, sub-Antarctic island called Marion, and a smaller one called Prince Edward.
Luganda: South Afirika erina ekitundu kyayo ekinene, ekisinga kya sub-Antarctic ekiyitibwa Marion ate n’ekitono ekiyitibwa Prince Edward.
Yoruba: South Africa ní ní agbègbè rẹ̀ gúúsù erékùsù Antarctic tí a pè ní Marion, àti èyí tí ó kéré, tí wọ́n ń pè ní Prince Edward.
Zulu: INingizimu Afrika inesiqhingi esikhulu, esingaphansi kwe-Antarctic ebizwa ngokuthi i-Marion, kanye nencane ebizwa ngokuthi i-Prince Edward.
Hausa: Afirka ta Kudu tana da wani babban yanki a yankin ƙaramin-Antatika mai suna Marion, da wani ƙarami mai suna Prince Edward.
Northern Sotho: Afrika Borwa ka gare ga naga ya yona e na le sehlakahlaka se segolo sa ka fasana ga Anthakthika seo se bitšwago Marion, le se sennyane seo se bitšwago Prince Edward.
Amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ በግዛቷ ውስጥ ትልቅ፣ የንዑስ አንታርክቲክ ደሴት ማሪዮን የተባለ፣ እና ትንሹ ደግሞ ልዑል ኤድዋርድ የሚባል አላት።

English: An island is a piece of land surrounded by water, and, because they are so isolated, are often home to unique plants and animals not found anywhere else.
Luganda: Ekizinga, kitundu kyattaka ekyetooloddwa amazzi, ate olw’okuba nti kiba kyesudde, kibeerako ebimera n’ensolo eby’enjawulo ebitaba wantu walala wonna.
Yoruba: Erékùsù jẹ́ ìdé ilẹ̀ tí omi yí ká, àti nítorípé wọ́n dáwà, wọ́n máa ń dúró gẹ́gẹ́ b́ ibùgbé fún onírúurú àwọn ewéko àti ẹranko tí a kò rí ní àwọn ibòmìíràn.
Zulu: Isiqhingi siyingxenye yezwe elizungezwe amanzi, futhi, ngenxa yokuthi ziqhelelene kakhulu, ngokuvamile ziyikhaya lezitshalo nezilwane eziyingqayizivele ezingatholakali kwenye indawo.
Hausa: Tsibiri yanki ne na ƙasa mai kewaye da ruwa, kuma, saboda sun keɓe, galibi suna kasancewa gida ne ga tsirrai da dabbobin da ba a samun su a wani wuri dabam.
Northern Sotho: Sehlakahlaka ke karolo ya naga ye e dikaneditšwego ke meetse, gomme, ka ge se arogane le naga kudu, gantši ke legae la dimela tše di swanago di nnoši le diphoofolo tšeo di sa hwetšagalego go gongwe.
Amharic: ደሴት በውሃ የተከበበ የመሬት ቁራጭ ነው፣ እና፣ በጣም የተገለሉ በመሆናቸው ምክንያት፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ለየት ላሉ እጽዋት እና ሌላ ቦታ ለማይገኙ እንስሳት መኖሪያ ናቸው።

English: Then species found in one place are introduced into new environments, they often become invasive, meaning that these non-native species thrive at the expense of native species or harm the native habitats in some other way.
Luganda: Endyo ezisangibwa mu kifo ekimu bwe zireetebwa mu kifo ekipya, zitera okweyisa mu ngeri y’okulumba, ekitegeeza nti endyo ezitali nnansangwa zeegazaanya n’okusinga ezo ze zisanzeewo oba ne zikosa endyo nnansangwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ní ìgbà tí a bá kó àwọn ọ́gánísíìmù tí a ṣe àwárí ní àwọn ibi kan lọ sí ibi tuntun, ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà ni wọ́n máa ń di àjòjì, èyí túnmọ̀ sí pé, àwọn àjòjì ọ́gánísíìmù wọ̀nyí a máa gbèrú nígbà tí ìyà a sì máa jẹ́ àwọn ojúlówó ọ́gánísíìmù tàbí kí wọ́n mú ìpalára bá àwọn ojúlówó ọ́gánísíìmù ní àwọn ọ̀nà mìíràn.
Zulu: Uma izinhlobo ezitholakala endaweni eyodwa zifakwa endaweni entsha, zivame ukuhlaseleka, okusho ukuthi lezi zinhlobo okungezona ezomdabu zikhula kahle ngokulahlekelwa yizinhlobo zemvelo noma zilimaze izindawo zokuhlala zendabuko ngenye indlela.
Hausa: Lokacin da aka shigar da jinsunan da ake samu a wuri guda a cikin sababbin mahalli, sukan zama masu mamayewa, ma'ana cewa waɗannan jinsunan da ba na asali ba suna bunƙasa ne ta hanyar kashe jinsuna na asali ko kuma cutar da mazaunan asali ta wata hanya dabam.
Northern Sotho: Ge mehuta ya diphedi ye e hwetšagalago lefelong le tee e tliva ditikologong tše diswa, gantši di thoma go šwahlela, go era gore diphedi tšeo di sego tša fao ka tlhago di a phela ka go šitela diphedi tša fao tša tlhago goba tša senya madulo a diphedi tša tlhago ka tsela ye nngwe.
Amharic: በአንድ ቦታ የሚገኙ ዝርያዎች ወደ አዲስ አካባቢ ሲገቡ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ወራሪዎች ይሆናሉ፣ ይህ ማለት እነዚህ አገር በቀል ያልሆኑ ዝርያዎች በአገር በቀል ዝርያዎች ዋጋ የሚበለጽጉ ወይም የአገሬውን መኖሪያዎች በሌላ መንገድ የሚጎዱ ናቸው።

English: In a 2020 book chapter, researchers said a total of 46 species were introduced to Marion Island, of which 29 caused harm.
Luganda: Mu ssuula y’omu kitabo ekyafuluma mu 2020, abanoonyereza baagamba nti endyo 46 zaaleetebwa mu kizinga Marion Island, era nga 29 ku zo zaaleeta okukosebwa.
Yoruba: Nínú orí ìwé kan tí wọhn kọ ní ọdún 2020, àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé irúfẹ́ ọ́gánísíìmù 46 ní wọ́n gbé wọ Marion Island, nínú èyí tí 29 wọn máa ń faewu.
Zulu: Esahlukweni sencwadi sango-2020, abacwaningi bathi ingqikithi yezinhlobo ezingama-46 zethulwe eMarion Island, okuyi-29 yazo yalimaza.
Hausa: A babi na wani littafin shekarar 2020, masu bincike sun ce an gabatar da jimillar jinsuna guda 46 a Tsibirin Marion, wanda a ciki guda 29 suke haifar da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka gare ga kgaolo ya puku ya 2020, banyakišiši ba boletše gore palomoka ya mehuta ya diphedi ye 46 e ile ya tlišwa ka sehlakahlakeng sa Marion Island, gomme mo go tšona tše 29 di ile tša baka tshenyo.
Amharic: በ2020ው የመፅሃፍ ምእራፍ፣ ተመራማሪዎች በአጠቃላይ 46 ዝርያዎች ወደ ማሪዮን ደሴት መግባታቸውንና፣ ከእነዚህም 29ኙ ጉዳት ማድረሳቸውን ተናግረዋል።

English: Only 8 species were introduced into Prince Edward Island, 7 of which were problematic.
Luganda: Endyo 8 zokka ze zaaleetebwa ku Prince Edward Island, ate nga 7 ku zo zaaliko omutawaana.
Yoruba: Irúfẹ́ ọ́gánísíìmù 8 ni wọ́n ṣí ojú wọ́n sí Prince Edward Island, tí 7 nínú wọn sì ní ìṣòro.
Zulu: Ziyisi-8 kuphela izinhlobo ezafakwa e-Prince Edward Island, eziyisi-7 zazo ezaziyinkinga.
Hausa: An shigar da jinsuna guda 8 kawai a cikin Tsibirin Prince Edward, guda 7 daga cikinsu suna da matsala.
Northern Sotho: Ke mehuta ye 8 fela yeo e ilego ya tlišwa ka Sehlakahlakeng sa Prince Edward, gomme mo go tšona tše 7 di be di baka mathata.
Amharic: ወደ ልዑል ኤድዋርድ ደሴት የገቡት 8 ዝርያዎች ብቻ ሲሆኑ፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ 7ቱ ችግር ያለባቸው ናቸው።

English: They said house mice, thought to have been brought to Marion Island by seal hunters around 1900, were the most problematic.
Luganda: Baagamba nti emmese z’omu nnyumba, ezaalowoozebwa nti abayizzi ba lukwata be baazireeta awo nga mu 1900, ze zaasinga okuba ez’omutawaana.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn léro pé eku ilé èyí tí àwọn ọdẹ-Síìlì kówọ Marion Island ní 1900, ni ó ní ìṣòro jùlọ.
Zulu: Bathe amagundane asendlini, okucatshangwa ukuthi alethwa abazingeli bezimvu zamanzi eMarion Island ngeminyaka yawo-1900, yiwo abeyinkinga kakhulu.
Hausa: Sun ce ɓerayen gida, da ake tunanin an kawo su Tsibirin Marion ta hanyar mafarautan zakin teku a wajajen shekarar 1900, su ne mafi matsala.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore magotlo a ka ntlong, ao go bego go naganwa gore a tlišitšwe ka sehlakahlakeng sa Marion Island ke batsomi ba disili mengwageng ya bo 1900, le yona e be e tliša mathata.
Amharic: በ1900 አካባቢ በባህር አንበሳ አዳኞች ወደ ማሪዮን ደሴት እንደመጡ የሚታሰቡት፣ የቤት አይጦች፣ በጣም ችግር እንዳለባቸው ተናግረዋል።

English: Seals are sea animals, which were at the time hunted for their fur to make expensive clothes.
Luganda: Lukwata nsolo za mayanja, era nga mu kiseera ekyo zaali ziyiggibwa okuziggyako omwoya gwazo okukolamu engoye ez’ebbeeyi.
Yoruba: Síìlì jẹ́ irúfẹ́ ẹranko inú omí, èyí tí wọ́n pa kí wọ́n le è lo awọ ara wọn láti ṣe àwọn aṣo olówó iyebíye.
Zulu: Izinja zamanzi ziyizilwane zasolwandle, ngaleso sikhathi ezazizingelwa uboya bazo ukuze kwenziwe izingubo ezibizayo.
Hausa: Zakunan teku dabbobin teku ne, waɗanda a lokacin ake farautar gashin su don yin tufafi masu tsada.
Northern Sotho: Disili ke diphoofolo tša ka lewatleng, tšeo ka nako yeo di bego di tsongwa gore go hwetšwe boya bja tšona bja go dira diaparo tša go tura.
Amharic: የባህር አንበሶች የባህር እንስሳት ሲሆኑ፣ በወቅቱ ፀጉራቸውን በመጠቀም ውድ ልብሶችን ለመሥራት ይታደኑ ነበር።

English: The mice brought by the seal hunters ate plant seeds, damaged and even killed plants.
Luganda: Emmese ezaaleetebwa abayizzi balukwata zaalya ensigo z’ebimera, zaakosa era ne zitta n’ebimera.
Yoruba: Àwọn eku tí àwọn ọlọ́dẹ-síìlì kó wá wọ̀nyí jẹ èso ewéko, tí wọ́n bà á jẹ́, tí wọ́n tilẹ̀ tún pa á run.
Zulu: Amagundane alethwa abazingeli bezimvu zamanzi adla imbewu yezitshalo, ezonakalisiwe ngisho nezibulala izitshalo.
Hausa: Ɓerayen da masu farautar zakin teku suka kawo suna cin irin shuka, suna lalata har ma da kashe tsirrai.
Northern Sotho: Magotlo ao a tlišitšwego ke batsomi ba disili a be a eja dipeu tša dimela, a senya le go bolaya dimela.
Amharic: የባህር አንበሳ አዳኞች ያመጧቸው አይጦች የእጽዋት ዘሮችን ይበላሉ፣ እፅዋትን አበላሽተዋል አልፎ ተርፎም ተክሎችን ገድለዋል።

English: They also ate too many insects and birds.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era zaalya ebiwuka n’ebinyonyi bingi.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni wọ́n jẹ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ kòkòrò àti ẹyẹ.
Zulu: Baphinde badla izinambuzane nezinyoni eziningi kakhulu.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma suna cii ƙwari da tsuntsaye da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Gape a be a eja dikhunkhwane tše ntši kudu le dinonyana.
Amharic: በጣም ብዙ ነፍሳትንና ወፎችንም ጭምር በልተዋል።

English: The authors said those insects were important for breaking down plant residues to make the soil fertile.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti ebiwuka ebyo byali byamugaso nnyo mu kumenyaamenya ebisigalira by’ebimera ebyagimusanga ettaka.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé sọ pé àwọn kòkòrò wọ̀nyẹn ṣe pàtàkì fún ṣíṣe àtúpalẹ̀ ràlẹ̀rálẹ̀ eweko láti mú kí ilẹ̀ túbọ̀ ní ọ̀rá.
Zulu: Ababhali bathe lezo zinambuzane zibalulekile ekubhidlizeni izinsalela zezitshalo ukuze umhlabathi uvunde.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce waɗannan ƙwari suna da mahimmanci don karya ragowar tsirrai don sa ƙasa ta sami albarkar noma.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore dikhunkhwane tšeo di be di le bohlokwa go aroganya mašaledi a dimela go dira gore mobu o none.
Amharic: እነዚያ ነፍሳት የእጽዋት ቅሪቶችን በመሰባበር አፈሩ ለም እንዲሆን ይጠቅሙ ነበሩ ብለዋል ደራሲዎቹ።

English: The government was to eradicate the mice by 2021, and previously, in 1948, they had introduced domestic cats to help control the mice.
Luganda: Gavumenti yali etegese okusaanyaawo emmese ezo 2021 we gwatuukira, ate era ne mu kusooka mu 1948, baali batutteyo emmese z’awaka ziyambeko mu kumalawo emmese ezo.
Yoruba: Ní bí 2021 ni ó ti yẹ kí àwọn ìjọba pa eku run, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni tẹ́lẹ̀, ní ọdún 1948, wọn ṣe ìgbéjáde ológbò ilé láti mú àdínkù bá bí àwọn ekù ṣe ń gbòòrò.
Zulu: Uhulumeni wayezowaqeda nya amagundane ngo-2021, futhi phambilini, ngo-1948, babethule amakati afuywayo ukusiza ukulawula amagundane.
Hausa: Gwamnati za ta kawar da ɓerayen nan dagas shekarar 2021, kuma a baya, a cikin shekarar 1948, sun gabatar da magunan gida don taimakawa wajen magance ɓerayen.
Northern Sotho: Mmušo o be o nyaka go fediša magotlo a ka ngwaga wa 2021, gomme mo nakong ye e fetilego, ka 1948, ba ile ba tliša dikatse tša ka gae go thuša go laola magotlo ao.
Amharic: መንግሥት በ2021 አይጦቹን ሙሉ በሙሉ ማጥፋት የነበረበት ሲሆን፣ ከዚህ ቀደም፣ በ1948፣ አይጦቹን ለመቆጣጠር የሚረዱ የቤት ውስጥ ድመቶችን አስገብተዋል።

English: However, these cats also fed on seabirds and greatly reduced their numbers, so the island management eradicated the cats in 1991 through hunting, trapping, and poisoning.
Luganda: Wabula, kkapa ezo ate nazo zaalyanga ebinyonyi by’oku nnyanja era ne zikendeeza nnyo omuwendo gwabyo, ate olwo abaddukanya ekizinga ne basaanyaawo kkapa ezo mu 1991 nga baziyigga, bazitega wamu n’okuziwa obutwa.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n síbẹ̀, àwọn ológbò wọ̀nyí náà máa ń jẹ ẹyẹ-omi, tí wọ́n sì tún ń mú àdínkù bá iye wọn, fún ìdí èyí, ní ọdún 1991, àwọn alákóso erékùsù pa àwọn ológbò run nípa dídọdẹ, dídẹ páńpẹ́ àti fífún wọn ní májèlé.
Zulu: Nokho, la makati nawo adla izinyoni zasolwandle futhi anciphisa kakhulu inani lazo, ngakho abaphathi beziqhingi baqeda la makati ngo-1991 ngokuzingela, ukucupha, nokudlisa ushevu.
Hausa: Duk da haka, waɗannan maguna kuma suna cinye da tsuntsayen teku kuma sun rage yawan su sosai, don haka hukumomin tsibirin sun kawar da magunan a shekarar 1991 ta hanyar farauta da tarko da kuma guba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, dikatse tše le tšona di be di eja dinonyana tša ka lewatle gomme tša fokotša kudu diplao tša tšona, ka fao balaodi ba sehlakahlaka se ba ile ba fediša dikatse tše ka ngwaga wa 1991 ka go di tsoma, go di thea, le go di fa mpholo.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ፣ እነዚህ ድመቶች የባህር ወፎችምን የሚመገቡ ሲሆን ይህም ቁጥራቸውን በእጅጉ ቀንሶታል፣ ስለዚህ የደሴቲቱ አስተዳደር ድመቶቹን በ1991 በአደን፣ በማጥመድ፣ እና በመመረዝ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲጠፉ አድርጓል።

English: The authors also said domestic pigs, sheep, goats, chickens, domestic dogs and parrots, had been introduced to Marion but later removed.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti embizzi z’awaka, endiga, embuzi, enkoko n’embwa z’awaka n’enkusu byali bitwaliddwa ku Marion naye oluvannyuma ne biggyibwayo.
Yoruba: Àwọn oǹkọ̀wé tún sọ pé wọ́n ti fi ìgbà kan ṣí ojú, àwọn ẹlẹ́dẹ̀ ilé, àgùntàn, ewuúrẹ́, adìyẹ, ajá ilé àti ayékòótọ́ sí Marion, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n padà yọ wọ́n.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bathi izingulube ezifuywayo, izimvu, izimbuzi, izinkukhu, izinja ezifuywayo kanye nopholi, bake bethulwa kuMarion kodwa babuye bakhishwa.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma ce an gabatar da aladun gida da tumaki da awaki da kaji da karnukan gida da aku, ga Marion amma daga baya an cire su.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gape gore dikolobe tša ka gae, dinku, dipudi, dikgogo, dimpša tša ka gae le dipharote le tšona di tlišitšwe ka sehlakahlakeng sa Marion eupša ka moragonyana tša tlošwa.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በተጨማሪም የቤት አሳማዎች፣ በጎች፣ ፍየሎች፣ ዶሮዎች፣ የቤት ውስጥ ውሾች እና በቀቀኖች፣ ወደ ማሪዮን ቢያስገቡም በኋላ ግን ተወግደዋል።

English: The authors reported a total of 27 introduced species of insects, flies, butterflies and moths on both islands.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti endyo 27 ze zaatwalibwayo omwali ebiwuka, enswera, n’ebiwojjolo.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé ṣe ìfiléde onírúurú àfòmọ́ kòkòrò, eṣinṣin, àti labalábá 27 ní erékùsù méjèèjì.
Zulu: Ababhali babike ingqikithi yezinhlobo ezingama-27 ezethulwe zezinambuzane, izimpukane, izimvemvane namabhu kuzo zombili iziqhingi.
Hausa: Mawallafan sun bayar da rahoton jimillar jinsuna guda 27 na ƙwari da ƙudaje da kuma malam buɗe mana littafi da aka gabatar a duka tsibiran biyu.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba begile gore palomoka ya mehuta ye 27 ya dikhunkhwane, dintšhi, dirurubele le dimmoto e ile ya tlišwa ka mo dihlakahlakeng tše.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ በሁለቱም ደሴቶች ላይ በአጠቃላይ 27 የነፍሳት፣ የዝንቦች፣ የቢራቢሮዎችና የእሳት እራቶች ዝርያዎችን አስገብተዋል።

English: They however said Marion Island had more invasive insects because it was more frequently visited.
Luganda: Wabula, ate baagamba nti Ekizinga Marion kyaliko ebiwuka ebigwira bingiko kubanga kyagendangako abantu bangi.
Yoruba: Ṣíbẹ̀, wọ́n tún sọ pé Marion Island ní àfòmọ́ kòkòrò jùlọ nítorípé àwọn ènì¥àn máa ń lọ ibẹ̀ lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀.
Zulu: Nokho bathi iMarion Island inezinambuzane eziningi ezihlaselayo ngoba ivakashelwa kakhulu.
Hausa: Sai dai sun ce Tsibirin Marion ya fi yawan ƙwari masu mamayewa saboda ana yawan ziyarta.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale ba boletše gore Marion Island e bile le dikhunkhwane tše ntši tša go šwahlela ka ge e be e etelwa kgafetšakgafetša.
Amharic: እነሱ ግን ማሪዮን ብዙ ጊዜ ይጎበኝ የነበረ ደሴት በመሆኑ ብዙ ወራሪ ነፍሳት እንደነበሩት ተናግረዋል።

English: The insects had come in through fresh fruit and vegetables, dry foods, and building materials brought to the island, and it would be difficult to eradicate them.
Luganda: Ebiwuka ebyo byagendangayo nga bitwalibwa ku bibala ebibisi n’ebivaava, emmere enkalu, n’ebizimbisibwa era nti kirabika kizibu okubiyigganya ne biggwaako.
Yoruba: Láti ara àwọn èso àti ewéko, oúnjẹ́ gbígbẹ, àti àwọn ohun èlò ìkọ́lé tí wọ́n kó wọ erúkùsù, àti pé ó máaa nira láti pa wọ́n rẹ́.
Zulu: Lezi zinambuzane zazingene ngezithelo nemifino emisha, ukudla okomile, nezinto zokwakha ezazilethwe esiqhingini, futhi kwakuyoba nzima ukuziqeda.
Hausa: Ƙwarin sun shigo ne ta hanyar sababbin ’ya’yan itace da ganyaye da busassun abinci, da kayan gini da aka kawo tsibirin, kuma zai yi wuya a kawar da su.
Northern Sotho: Dikhunkhwane tše di tlile mo sehlakahlakeng se ka dikenya le merogo ye foreše, dijo tša go omišwa, le dikago tšeo di tlišitšwego mo sehlakahlakeng, gomme go ka ba boima go di fediša.
Amharic: ነፍሳቱ ትኩስ አትክልትና ፍራፍሬዎች፣ የደረቁ ምግቦች፣ እና ወደ ደሴቱ በመጡት የግንባታ ቁሳቁሶች አማካኝነት ገብተው ነበር፣ እና እነሱን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማጥፋት አስቸጋሪ ነበር።

English: As for plants, the authors said 17 have been introduced to both islands, mainly through building materials, fodder or birds.
Luganda: Ate byo ebisolo, abawandiisi baagamba nti 17 bye byatwalibwayo ku bizinga byombi, nga biyitira mu bizimbisibwa, emmere y’ebisolo oba ebinyonyi.
Yoruba: Ní ti àwọn ewéko, àwọn òǹkọ̀wé sọ pé àwọn àfòmọ́ 17 ni wọ́n ṣí lójú sí erékùsù méjèèjì, pàápàá jùlọ láti ara àwọn ohun èlò ìkọ́lé, oúnjẹ́ màlúù tàbí àwọn ẹyẹ.
Zulu: Ngokuqondene nezitshalo, ababhali bathi i-17 yethulwe kuzo zombili iziqhingi, ikakhulukazi ngezinto zokwakha, ifolishi noma izinyoni.
Hausa: Dangane da tsirrai, marubutan sun ce an gabatar da guda 17 zuwa tsibiran biyu, galibi ta hanyar kayan gini ko abinci ko kuma tsuntsaye.
Northern Sotho: Mabapi le dimela, bangwadi ba boletše gore dimela tše 17 di tlišitšwe ka dihlakahlakeng tše ka bobedi, kudukudu ka dikago, ka furu goba ka dinonyana.
Amharic: እፅዋትን በተመለከተ፣ ደራሲዎቹ እንዳሉት 17ቱም ወደ ሁለቱም ደሴቶች የገቡት፣ በዋናነት በግንባታ ዕቃዎች፣ በከብቶች ደረቅ መኖ ወይም በአእዋፍ ነው።

English: Out of those, 8 in Marion and 3 in Prince Edward were causing harm.
Luganda: Ku ebyo, 8 ku Marion ate 3 ku Prince Edward bye byali bivaako akasandali.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí, 8 ni Marion àti 3 ní Prince Edward ní wọ́n ń fa ewu.
Zulu: Kulabo, abayisi-8 kuMarion naba-3 ePrince Edward bebedala umonakalo.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗancan, guda 8 a cikin Marion da kuma guda 3 a cikin Prince Edward suna haifar da lahani.
Northern Sotho: Go tšona, tše 8 ka Marion le tše 3 ka Prince Edward di be di baka tshenyo.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ውስጥ፣ 8ቱ በማሪዮን እና 3ቱ ደግሞ በልዑል ኤድዋርድ ጉዳት እያደረሱ ነበር።

English: They said researchers have not studied invasive microorganisms on the islands in detail yet.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abanoonyereza tebannaba kunoonyereza mu bwesovvu ku buwuka obusirikiti obugwira ku kizinga.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn olùwádìí kò ì tíì ṣe ìwádìí àwọn àfòmọ́ ohun abàmì kékèké ní àwọn erékùsù tó bí ó ti tọ́ àti bí ó ti yẹ.
Zulu: Bathe abacwaningi abakacwaningi ngokuningiliziwe ngama-microorganisms ahlaselayo eziqhingini.
Hausa: Sun ce masu bincike ba su yi nazarin ƙananan halittu masu mamaya a tsibirin dalla-dalla ba tukuna.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore banyakišiši ga se ba hlwa ba nyakišiša ka ga diphedinyana tša go šwahlela ka dihlakahlakeng ka botlalo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እስካሁን በደሴቶቹ ላይ ያሉ ወራሪ ረቂቅ ተሕዋስያን እስካሁን ድረስ በዝርዝር አልተጠኑም ብለዋል ።

English: Microorganisms are tiny living things that cannot be seen without special equipment, such as viruses, bacteria and certain fungi.
Luganda: Obuwuka obusirikiti buba butono kutwala wala era nga tebusobola kulabika na maaso watali byuma byanjawulo, gamba ng’obuwuka obuleeta endwadde, bakitiiriya n’ebika bya fungi ebimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun abàmì kékèké jẹ́ àwọn ohun abẹ̀mí tí ó kéré púpọ̀ tí ènìyàn kò le è fi ojú lásán rí láì lo irinṣẹ́, bíi fáírọ́ọ̀sì, bakitéríà àti àwọn olú.
Zulu: Ama-microorganisms ayizinto eziphilayo ezincane ezingenakubonwa ngaphandle kwemishini ekhethekile, njengamagciwane, amagciwane kanye nesikhunta esithile.
Hausa: Ƙananan halittu wasu ‘yan mitsitsan halittu ne masu rai waɗanda ba za a iya gani ba sai tare da kayan aiki na musamman, kamar ƙwayoyin cuta da bakteriya da kuma wasu fungi.
Northern Sotho: Diphedinyana le diphedi tše nnyane kudu tšeo di ka se kgone go bonwa ka ntle le go diriša setlabelo seo se kgethegilego, tšona di swana le dibaerase, dipaktheria le difankase tše dingwe.
Amharic: ረቂቅ ተሕዋስያን እንደ ቫይረሶች፣ ባክቴሪያ እና አንዳንድ ፈንገሶች ያሉ ከልዩ መሳሪያ ውጭ ሊታዩ የማይችሉ ጥቃቅን ህይወት ያላቸው ነገሮች ናቸው።

English: Only 1 fungus that attacks cabbage leaves has been reported in Marion island so far.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kino, ekika kya fungus 1 kyokka kye kirabiddwako ku Kizinga Marion.
Yoruba: Olú 1 ṣoṣo tí ó gbógun ti ewé kabéjì ní wọ́n ṣe ìfiléde rẹ̀ ní erékùsù Marion láti ìgbà yí.
Zulu: Isikhunta esi-1 kuphela esihlasela amaqabunga eklabishi okubikiwe esiqhingini sase-Marion kuze kube manje.
Hausa: Fungus 1 ne kawai aka rawaito yake kai hari ga ganyen kabeji a Tsibirin Marion ya zuwa yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Ke fela fankase ye 1 yeo e hlaselago matlakala a khabetšhe yeo e begilwego ka sehlakahlakeng sa Marion go fihla mo lebakeng le.
Amharic: እስካሁን በማሪዮን ደሴት የጥቅል ጎመን ቅጠሎችን የሚያጠቃ 1 ፈንገስ ብቻ ተዘግቧል።

English: They also said only 2 fish species were known to have been introduced to the islands, even though they were no longer there.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti endyo z’ebyennyanja bbiri zokka ze zaali zimanyiddwa okubeera nga zaatwalibwa ku bizinga ebyo, wadde nga zaali tezikyaliyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé irúfẹ́ ẹ̀yà ẹja 2 ní wọ́n mọ̀ pé ó di àfihàn sí àwọn erékùsù, bí ó tilẹ jẹ́ pé wọn kò sí ní ibẹ mọ́.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi zi-2 kuphela izinhlobo zezinhlanzi okwaziwayo ukuthi ezethulwe eziqhingini, yize zazingasekho.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun ce nau'in kifi 2 ne kawai aka san an shigar da su tsibirin, duk da cewa ba sa nan.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore ke fela mehuta ye 2 fela ya dihlapi yeo e bego e tsebja gore e tlišitšwe ka mo dihlakahlakeng tše, le ge e le gore di be di sa hlwe di le fao.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ምንም እንኳን አሁን ባይገኙም፣ ወደ ደሴቶቹ መግባታቸው የሚታወቁ 2 የዓሣ ዝርያዎች ብቻ ነበሩ።

English: These findings highlight the existing and potential harm of invasive species on these two South African islands.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa ebyo bitangaaza bulungi ku busobosi bw’okukosebwa okuva ku ndyo engwira ku bizinga bya South Afirika ebyo ebibiri.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe àfihàn àwọn ewu àwọn àjòjì ọ́gánísíìmù tí ó ti fojú hàn àti àwọn tí ó ṣe é ṣe kí ó tún fojú hàn ní àwọn erékùsù South Africa méjì yìí.
Zulu: Lokhu okutholakele kugqamisa ukulimala okukhona kanye nokungaba khona kwezilwane ezihlaselayo kulezi ziqhingi ezimbili zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon binciken sun nuna alamun da suke akwai da kuma yiwuwar cutarwar jinsuna masu mamayewa a waɗannan tsibiran Afirka ta Kudu guda biyu.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tše di laetša go ba gona le kotsi ye e ka kgonagalago ya mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela ka mo dihlakahlakeng tše pedi tše tša Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: እነዚህ ግኝቶች በእነዚህ ሁለት የደቡብ አፍሪካ ደሴቶች ላይ ወራሪ ዝርያዎች ያላቸውን ነባር እና ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ጉዳቶችን ያሳያሉ።

English: The authors therefore recommended that island authorities should strictly adhere to and enforce policies to manage invasive species, and they called for further research to identify other invasive species.
Luganda: Awo nno abawandiisi baasemba nti aboobuyinza ku bizinga ebyo balina okugoberera n’okukwasiza amateeka okusobola okufuga endyo engwira, era baakuba omulanga wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala okunaazuula endyo endala engwira.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn òǹkọ̀wé gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn pé kí àwọn aláṣẹ erékùsù rí i dájú pé wọ́n mú u ní kàńpá fún àwọn ènìyàn láti tẹ̀lé òfin ìṣètò àjòjì ọ́gánísíìmù, bákan náà niwọhn pè fún àṣekún iṣẹ́ ìwadìí láti ṣe àwárí àwọn àjòjì ọ́gánísíìmù mìíràn.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke ababhali batusa ukuthi iziphathimandla zeziqhingi kufanele zibambelele ngokuqinile futhi ziphoqelele izinqubomgomo zokulawula izinhlobo zezilwane ezihlaselayo, futhi bacela ukuba kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuze kutholakale ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane ezihlaselayo.
